title: China injecting children to raise IQ
summary: Kurt Metzger tells of China injecting children to raise IQ, about 2020s at China, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

plain: Kurt Metzger, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, says that Joe Rogan, a well-known podcast host, told him that intelligence officials had told Rogan something. According to that chain of people, China was injecting its children with something to raise their intelligence.
